# Okkok

> Okkok audits a built iOS or Android app against the App Store and Google Play rules, never the source, and says on every finding how it knows. Open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later) by Editerra AB, Sweden. Command: `okkok audit <app>`. Install: `pip install git+https://github.com/petresandu-cloud/okkok`.

Okkok reads the .ipa, .app, .apk or .aab, the listing text and the declaration files. It checks 88 rules from the App Review Guidelines, Apple's privacy requirements and the Play Developer Program Policies. Every finding carries provenance: checked directly, a reviewer said so, inferred, needs a console read, needs a phone. It never stores the stores' own text; it fingerprints 113 rule pages on every run and publishes changes in its own words.

## Start here

- [Rejected? Start here](https://editerra.se/okkok/rejections/index.html): the rejections developers search for most and the checks that catch them.
- [Every rule](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/index.html): one page per rule, in our words, linked to its source.
- [Store rule changes](https://editerra.se/okkok/changes.html): the change log, with RSS at https://editerra.se/okkok/changes.xml.
- [Sample report](https://editerra.se/okkok/sample-report.html): a real report on an open-source Android app.
- [Source and README](https://github.com/petresandu-cloud/okkok)
- [Commercial terms](https://github.com/petresandu-cloud/okkok/blob/main/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md)

## Rules

- [A Kids Category app has a parental gate, no third-party analytics or ads, and sends no identifying data to third parties](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.1.3.kids-category.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [A VPN app uses NEVPNManager, declares data use on a screen first, and commits to sell nothing](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.4.vpn.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [A health-related app files the Health apps declaration and carries the not-a-medical-device disclaimer](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.health-apps-declaration.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [A news or magazine app declares itself and names sources, contact and preview](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.news-app-declaration.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [A social, dating or stranger-chat app meets the Child Safety Standards](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.child-safety-standards.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [A subscription says what the price buys, lasts at least a week, and works on all the user's devices](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.3.1.2.subscription-terms-clear.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [A third-party social login is matched by Sign in with Apple](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.8.sign-in-with-apple-alongside-social-login.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Ads fit the rating, are dismissible, stay inside the app, and never imitate the interface](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.ads-behave.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [An IARC content rating exists and matches the app's content](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.content-rating-filed.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [An app outside the Kids Category shows nothing that says children are its main audience](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.1.4.no-child-appeal-outside-kids.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [An app that generates content with AI lets users report offensive output in the app](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.ai-content-reporting.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [An app that lets one person see another's location or activity is not a monitoring app, or is a lawful one](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.not-stalkerware.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [An app that tracks asks with the App Tracking Transparency prompt](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.tracking-prompt-when-tracking.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [An app whose audience includes children meets the Families requirements: certified ads, no personalised ads, age screen, disclosed data](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.families-requirements.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [An app with a login gives Google a working demo account and everything needed to review it](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.demo-account-for-review.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [An app with a login gives the reviewer a working demo account or an approved demo mode](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.2.1.demo-account-for-login.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [An app with accounts lets people delete the account from inside the app](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.account-deletion-in-app.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [An app with financial features files the Financial features declaration and meets the loan rules](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.financial-features-declared.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Anything unlocked inside the app is sold through in-app purchase, with restore and no expiry](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.3.1.1.digital-unlocks-use-in-app-purchase.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [App Transport Security is not switched off wholesale](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.1.6.transport-security-not-disabled.html): Likely to be questioned, App Store.
- [Apple Pay shows all purchase information before the sale, and recurring terms in full](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.9.apple-pay-disclosures.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Asking to ignore battery optimisation is allowed only for apps whose core function breaks otherwise](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.battery-optimisation-bypass-eligible.html): Likely to be questioned, Google Play.
- [Background location is used only for a core feature, disclosed, and declared in the console](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.background-location-is-core.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Background work is limited to the declared feature and does not drain the battery](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.2.4.background-power.html): Likely to be questioned, App Store.
- [Bundled extensions are disclosed in the listing and carry no ads, marketing or purchases](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.4.extensions-disclosed.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Contests, gambling and lotteries are licensed, geo-restricted, free, and never funded by in-app purchase](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.3.gaming-gambling-lotteries.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Cryptocurrency features stay within what Apple allows: no mining on device, licensed exchanges, organisation-enrolled wallets](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.3.1.5.cryptocurrency.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Device-management features come with Apple's permission, an upfront data declaration and no data sales](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.5.device-management.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Digital purchases use Play billing, nothing steers users elsewhere, and prices match the Play bill](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.play-billing-for-digital-goods.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Each purpose string says what the app does with the access, not just that it wants it](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.purpose-strings-say-why.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Every bundled framework on Apple's SDK list carries a privacy manifest](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.listed-sdk-frameworks-carry-manifests.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Every capability the code uses has a purpose string in Info.plist](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.purpose-string-for-every-used-capability.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Every declared background mode matches something the code actually does](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.background-modes-are-used.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Every foreground service type has its matching permission, and is declared in Play Console](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.foreground-service-types-declared.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Every purpose-string key in Info.plist is one Apple defines](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.purpose-string-keys-are-real.html): Likely to be questioned, App Store.
- [Every restricted permission declared meets its own condition: default handler, review, declaration, or core purpose](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.restricted-permissions.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Every sensitive permission declared is one the compiled code references](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.permissions-are-used.html): Likely to be questioned, Google Play.
- [Everything in the app and its listing is the developer's own or licensed, and nothing suggests Apple's endorsement](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.2.only-owned-or-licensed-content.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Financial, health, VPN or government apps come from an organisation account](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.organisation-account-where-required.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [From 27 January 2027, READ_CONTACTS needs a declaration that the Contact Picker is not enough](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.contacts-picker-from-2027.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [From 30 September 2026 the app's package name is registered in Play Console for developer verification](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.package-registered-for-verification.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Gambling, dating, stranger-chat or anonymous-chat apps block minors with Play Console tools](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.age-restricted-blocks-minors.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Health, fitness or motion data is used only for the user's benefit, disclosed, never sold, never in iCloud](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.1.3.health-data.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [If the app declares itself a monitoring tool, it is parent-child or employer-employee only, with notification, icon and disclosure](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.monitoring-tool-flag.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [If the build claims iPad, iPad is reviewed and needs its own screenshots](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.ipad-is-a-claim.html): Worth knowing, App Store.
- [If users can post content or interact, the app can filter, report, block, and shows contact details](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.1.2.user-content-moderation.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [In-app deletion exists and a web page for deleting without the app is declared](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.account-deletion-web-link.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Listing texts fit the stores' length limits](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.listing-lengths.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Loans, trading, insurance, fundraising and gifts follow the business-model rules](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.3.2.money-features-licensed.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Mini apps, streaming games, chatbots, plug-ins or emulator games the app offers follow the hosting rules](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.7.hosted-software.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [No guarantee or emergency-service claim without a negation next to it](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.no-unqualified-claims.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [No objectionable content, and no fake or joke features such as a fake location tracker](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.1.1.no-objectionable-or-fake-features.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [No paid feature is merely a built-in capability such as push, camera or gyroscope](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.10.no-selling-built-in-capabilities.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [No placeholder or temporary text anywhere in the listing](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.2.1.no-placeholder-text.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Nothing in the app imitates a system warning, another app, or a store interface](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.no-fake-system-warnings.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Nothing is locked behind rating, reviewing, or installing other apps](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.3.2.2.no-forced-store-actions.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Nothing the app says presents location as an emergency service](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.location-not-emergency.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Nothing tricks people into purchases, unnecessary data sharing or undelivered features](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.6.no-manipulative-practices.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Notifications carry the app's own features, never ads or another app, and look like the app's](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.notifications-only-for-the-apps-own-features.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [One app, not many near-identical ones, and not a near-duplicate of a worn-out category](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.3.not-spam.html): Likely to be questioned, Both stores.
- [Personal data does not travel over plain HTTP](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.no-cleartext-traffic.html): Likely to be questioned, Google Play.
- [Precise location is justified in the location-scope declaration](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.location-scope-declaration.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Ratings are requested only through Apple's review prompt, never a custom one](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.5.6.1.system-review-prompt-only.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Subscription screens state cost, frequency, renewal and a way to continue without subscribing](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.subscription-transparency.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Targets the Android API level Google Play requires](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.target-api.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The Data safety form says what the app and its libraries actually collect](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.data-safety-matches-app.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The app never sends a message on the user's behalf without showing content and recipients first](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.no-messages-without-confirmation.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The app never tells people to restart the device or change unrelated system settings](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.2.4.no-forced-settings-changes.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The app offers real utility beyond a repackaged website and works without another app](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.2.more-than-a-website.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The app ships its own privacy manifest](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.privacy-manifest-present.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [The app stays usable when a person refuses a sensitive permission, and no feature is gated on turning one on](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.usable-when-permission-denied.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The app updates itself only through Play and downloads no executable code](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.no-executable-download.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The build is signed with an App Store profile and push is set to production](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.signed-for-the-store.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [The declared target audience matches the listing's look and words](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.target-audience-honest.html): Likely to be questioned, Google Play.
- [The full-screen intent permission is used only for calls or alarms, never for notifications or ads](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.full-screen-intent-justified.html): Likely to be questioned, Google Play.
- [The iOS build on disk is the app the source describes](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.built-matches-source.html): Likely to be questioned, App Store.
- [The in-app disclosure names the feature, the data, and that it happens in the background](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.background-location-disclosure-wording.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The name, icon and interface are the developer's own and impersonate nothing](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.4.1.not-a-copycat.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The privacy policy link in the listing opens and is a real page](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.privacy-policy-reachable.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The privacy policy names what is collected, who processes it, retention, deletion and consent withdrawal](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.privacy-policy-content.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The release package is not debuggable](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.release-not-debuggable.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [The store name is short, plain, and free of emoji, shouting and special characters](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.listing-name-rules.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [The support link opens a real page with a way to contact the developer](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.1.5.support-url-reachable.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Title, icon and developer name carry no emoji, shouting, ranking, price or programme claims, and no anonymous testimonials](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.listing-metadata-rules.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [Title, icon, description and screenshots describe what the app really does, in this version](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/both.listing-describes-the-app.html): Blocks submission, Both stores.
- [Tracking declarations agree with each other and with the tracking prompt](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/apple.privacy-manifest-tracking-consistent.html): Blocks submission, App Store.
- [Unless a licensed gambling operator, nothing lets users stake money for a prize of real value](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.no-real-money-prizes.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
- [What each bundled SDK collects is disclosed as the app's own, and no SDK sells data](https://editerra.se/okkok/rules/google.sdk-data-disclosed.html): Blocks submission, Google Play.
